name: Greater Weapon Focus
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a weapon you have Weapon Focus in. Another +1 bonus on attack rolls with it.

name: Weapon Specialization
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a weapon you have Weapon Focus in. +2 bonus on damage rolls with it.

name: Greater Weapon Specialization
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a weapon you have Weapon Specialization in. Another +2 bonus on damage rolls with it.

name: Penetrating Strike
description: Attacks with your Weapon Focus weapons ignore up to 5 points of damage reduction (not DR without a type).

name: Greater Penetrating Strike
description: Attacks with your Weapon Focus weapons ignore up to 10 points of damage reduction (5 against DR without a type).

name: Improved Critical
subject: Weapon
description: Double the threat range of a chosen weapon.

name: Exotic Weapon Proficiency
subject: Weapon
description: Choose an exotic weapon. Attack with it without the non-proficiency penalty.

name: Martial Weapon Proficiency
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a martial weapon. Attack with it without the non-proficiency penalty.

name: Simple Weapon Proficiency
description: Attack with simple weapons without penalty. Every class has this already except druids, monks, and wizards.

name: Weapon Finesse
description: Use your Dex modifier instead of Str on attack rolls with light weapons, elven curve blades, rapiers, whips, and spiked chains.

name: Dazzling Display
description: As a full-round action with your Weapon Focus weapon, make an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 feet.

name: Shatter Defenses
description: Shaken, frightened, or panicked foes you hit are flat-footed to your attacks until the end of your next turn.

name: Deadly Stroke
description: As a standard action, strike a stunned or flat-footed foe for double damage and 1 point of Constitution bleed.

name: Agile Maneuvers
description: Use your Dex bonus instead of your Str bonus when calculating your Combat Maneuver Bonus.

name: Defensive Combat Training
description: Treat your total Hit Dice as your base attack bonus when calculating Combat Maneuver Defense.

name: Improved Disarm
description: No attack of opportunity when you disarm. +2 on disarm checks and +2 CMD against being disarmed.

name: Greater Disarm
description: Another +2 on disarm checks. Weapons you knock away land 15 feet from their wielder.

name: Improved Feint
description: Feint in combat as a move action.

name: Greater Feint
description: Foes you feint lose their Dex bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Improved Trip
description: No attack of opportunity when you trip. +2 on trip checks and +2 CMD against being tripped.

name: Greater Trip
description: Another +2 on trip checks. Foes you trip provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Improved Bull Rush
description: No attack of opportunity when you bull rush. +2 on bull rush checks and +2 CMD against being bull rushed.

name: Greater Bull Rush
description: Another +2 on bull rush checks. Foes you bull rush provoke attacks of opportunity from your allies.

name: Improved Overrun
description: No attack of opportunity when you overrun. +2 on overrun checks and +2 CMD against being overrun. Targets can't choose to avoid you.

name: Greater Overrun
description: Another +2 on overrun checks. Foes you knock prone by overrunning provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Improved Sunder
description: No attack of opportunity when you sunder. +2 on sunder checks and +2 CMD against having your gear sundered.

name: Greater Sunder
description: Another +2 on sunder checks. Excess damage from destroying an item carries over to its wielder.

name: Combat Reflexes
description: Make a number of additional attacks of opportunity per round equal to your Dex bonus, even while flat-footed.

name: Stand Still
description: Use a combat maneuver check as an attack of opportunity to stop a foe from moving for the rest of its turn.

name: Mobility
description: +4 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity caused by your movement.

name: Spring Attack
description: As a full-round action, move, make one melee attack without provoking from its target, and keep moving.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: As a full-attack action, make one melee attack against every foe within reach.

name: Wind Stance
description: If you move more than 5 feet, gain 20% concealment against ranged attacks for 1 round.

name: Lightning Stance
description: If you take two move actions or a withdraw, gain 50% concealment for 1 round.
